claim: For the 2025 Q4 period, Coca-Cola cleared the $8.0B mark in gross profit.
summary: As of the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, Coca-Cola's verified gross profit for the 2025 Q4 period (ending Dec 31, 2025) had not been released, as Q4 results are typically reported in February 2026. Therefore the claim that it cleared $8.0B cannot be confirmed or contradicted with available knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Coca-Cola gross profit for 2025 Q4 was greater than $8.0B
sub_claims.stated_text: cleared the $8.0B mark in gross profit
sub_claims.note: No verified gross profit figure for Coca-Cola 2025 Q4 is available within the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04; Q4 2025 earnings would post-date the cutoff and no evidence can be cited.
